summary: The PR addresses the issue with QuerySet.none() on combined queries but introduces new files that should not be part of the core Django repository.

issues.description: The PR includes new files (reproduce.py, test_app/__init__.py, test_app/migrations/0001_initial.py, test_app/migrations/__init__.py) which are not appropriate for the core Django repository. These files should be part of a separate test suite or documentation.
